evals.prompt: Accept docs quest for elastic/docs-content#9999. I already have docs-content at ~/work/docs-content, pitfalls at ~/work/docs-pitfalls.md, and editorial preferences at ~/work/editorial-preferences.md.
evals.expected_output: Phase 0 records the three provided paths in docs-accept-quest.local.yml without copying or moving the existing files, then proceeds to read the issue.
expectations: Asks for unresolved writer paths only when they are not already provided
Does not overwrite or relocate existing pitfalls or editorial preference files
Writes or updates ~/.config/elastic-docs/docs-accept-quest.local.yml (or workspace local config) with the three paths
Continues to Phase 1 issue intake after paths are resolved

evals.prompt: Accept docs quest elastic/docs-content#1234 for a Kibana UI change with a linked implementation PR. Paths are already configured.
evals.expected_output: Triangulates the linked PR and sibling PRs, proposes a docs plan, verifies UI strings at HEAD, sweeps the pitfalls checklist, and opens a draft PR.
expectations: Reads the docs issue and linked product PR diff as the primary source of truth
Searches for sibling/follow-up PRs before drafting
Verifies UI labels against product source at HEAD, not issue prose
Reads $DOCS_PITFALLS_PATH and $EDITORIAL_PREFERENCES_PATH during verification and drafting
Opens a draft PR on elastic/docs-content

evals.prompt: First run of docs-accept-quest with no local config and no env vars. I do not have pitfalls or editorial preference files yet. docs-content is at /tmp/docs-content.
evals.expected_output: Seeds pitfalls and editorial preferences from the bundled example files to chosen paths, writes local config, then continues.
expectations: Offers to copy pitfalls.examples.md and editorial-preferences.example.md to user-chosen paths
Persists resolved paths so the next run skips first-run setup

evals.prompt: The docs issue says docs may not be needed for an invisible automatic change with no new user-facing control.
evals.expected_output: Runs the whether-to-document gate and recommends no docs or release note only before drafting.
expectations: Surfaces the whether-to-document gate before drafting
Does not open a docs PR until the user confirms documentation is warranted
